```{r, setup}
pacman::p_load(ggplot2, tidyverse, tidymodels, readr, here, broom, gt)

data <- read_csv(here("data", "clean_data.csv"))
```

# Cleaning

```{r}
snp_cols <- data |> 
  select(starts_with("rs")) |> 
  colnames()

data <- data |> 
  mutate(
    treatment = as.factor(treatment),
    sex = as.factor(sex),
    across(all_of(snp_cols), as.factor),     
    PR = factor(PR, levels = c("1", "0"))
  )
```

# Splitting

```{r}
set.seed(123)

# Why: split data to evaluate model on unseen data
split_PR <- initial_split(data, strata = PR)

train_PR <- training(split_PR)
test_PR  <- testing(split_PR)
```

# Workflow

```{r}
# Workflow
recipe_PR <- recipe(PR ~ treatment + age, data = train_PR) |>
  step_impute_mean(age) |>
  step_center(age) |>
  step_dummy(all_nominal_predictors())

model_PR <- logistic_reg() |> 
  set_engine("glm") |>
  set_mode("classification")

wf_PR <- workflow(recipe_PR,model_PR)

fit_PR <- fit(wf_PR, train_PR)

# Fit Model
fit_PR

fit_PR |> 
  extract_fit_parsnip() |> 
  tidy()

# Testing
pred_PR <- predict(fit_PR, test_PR, type = "prob") |>
  bind_cols(predict(fit_PR, test_PR, type = "class")) |>
  bind_cols(test_PR |> select(PR, age, treatment))

# Visualise
plot_PR <- expand_grid(
  age = seq(
    min(data$age, na.rm = TRUE),
    max(data$age, na.rm = TRUE),
    length.out = 200
  ),
  treatment = factor(c("A", "B", "C"), levels = levels(data$treatment))
)

plot_PR <- plot_PR |> 
  bind_cols(
    predict(fit_PR, new_data = plot_PR, type = "prob")
  )

ggplot(plot_PR, aes(x = age, y = .pred_1, colour = treatment, linetype = treatment)) +
  geom_line(linewidth = 1.3) +
  labs(
    title = "Predicted Probability of PR",
    x = "Age",
    y = "P(PR = 1)",
    colour = "Treatment",
    linetype = "Treatment"
  ) +
  theme_minimal()

# Metrics
roc_df <- roc_curve(pred_PR, truth = PR, .pred_1)
auc_val <- roc_auc(pred_PR, truth = PR, .pred_1)$.estimate
```

## simple model ##


```{r}
recipe_PR_simple <- recipe(PR ~ treatment, data = train_PR) |>
  step_dummy(all_nominal_predictors())

wf_PR_simple <- wf_PR |>
  update_recipe(recipe_PR_simple)

fit_PR_simple <- fit(wf_PR_simple, train_PR)

pred_PR_simple <- predict(fit_PR_simple, test_PR, type = "prob") |>
  bind_cols(predict(fit_PR_simple, test_PR, type = "class")) |>
  bind_cols(test_PR)

metrics(pred_PR_simple, truth = PR, estimate = .pred_class)

roc_auc(pred_PR_simple, truth = PR, .pred_1)

# ROC Curves

roc1 <- roc_curve(pred_PR, truth = PR, .pred_1) |> mutate(model = "Age + Treatment")
roc2 <- roc_curve(pred_PR_simple, truth = PR, .pred_1) |> mutate(model = "Treatment Only")

bind_rows(roc1, roc2) |>
  ggplot(aes(x = 1 - specificity, y = sensitivity, colour = model)) +
  geom_path(linewidth = 1) +
  geom_abline(linetype = "dashed") +
  theme_minimal()
```



```{r}
model_compare <- tibble(
  Model = c("Age + Treatment", "Treatment Only"),
  
  Accuracy = c(
    accuracy(pred_PR, truth = PR, estimate = .pred_class)$.estimate,
    accuracy(pred_PR_simple, truth = PR, estimate = .pred_class)$.estimate
  ),
  
  Sensitivity = c(
    sens(pred_PR, truth = PR, estimate = .pred_class)$.estimate,
    sens(pred_PR_simple, truth = PR, estimate = .pred_class)$.estimate
  ),
  
  Specificity = c(
    spec(pred_PR, truth = PR, estimate = .pred_class)$.estimate,
    spec(pred_PR_simple, truth = PR, estimate = .pred_class)$.estimate
  ),
  
  ROC_AUC = c(
    roc_auc(pred_PR, truth = PR, .pred_1)$.estimate,
    roc_auc(pred_PR_simple, truth = PR, .pred_1)$.estimate
  )
)

model_compare |>
  mutate(across(where(is.numeric), round, 3)) |>
  gt()
```


```{r}
snp_cols_valid <- snp_cols[
  map_lgl(snp_cols, ~ n_distinct(data[[.x]], na.rm = TRUE) > 1)
]

snp_tests <- map_df(snp_cols_valid, function(snp) {
  
  formula <- as.formula(paste("PR ~", snp))
  
  model <- glm(
    formula,
    data = data,
    family = "binomial"
  )
  
  tidy(model) |> 
    filter(term != "(Intercept)") |>
    mutate(snp = snp)
})

snp_tests <- snp_tests |> 
  mutate(p_adj = p.adjust(p.value, method = "fdr")) |>
  arrange(p_adj)

top_snps <- snp_tests |>
  slice_head(n = 5) |>
  select(snp, estimate, std.error, statistic, p.value, p_adj)

top_snps |>
  gt() |>
  cols_label(
    snp = "SNP",
    estimate = "Estimate",
    std.error = "Std. Error",
    statistic = "Z-value",
    p.value = "p-value",
    p_adj = "Adjusted p-value"
  ) |>
  fmt_number(
    columns = c(estimate, std.error, statistic),
    decimals = 3
  ) |>
  fmt_number(
    columns = c(p.value, p_adj),
    decimals = 3
  ) |>
  tab_header(
    title = "Top 5 SNPs Associated with Positive Response",
    subtitle = "Ranked by adjusted p-value"
  )
```
